newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo repeats no deal on Mitsubishi motor.
newsitem.headline: Volvo repeats no deal on Mitsubishi motor.

text.p: Swedish vehicle maker AB Volvo on Friday repeated it had not signed an accord with Mitsubishi Motors Corp relating to its GDI engines for cars produced at its Dutch joint venture.
"I have checked with the engine unit and we have not signed a formal agreement with Mitsubishi about buying motors," Volvo Car spokesman Ingmar Hesslefors told Reuters.

Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported earlier that Volvo had agreed to buy Mitsubishi's gasoline direct injection (GDI) engines and that Volvo would start selling passengers cars equipped with them from late 1997.

A Mitsubishi spokeswoman said the report was true, but declined to say how many engines Mitsubishi would supply and when the agreement would take effect because such information could affect Volvo's sales strategies.
